title: Decision: draft-mahy-mls-credential-by-ref-00 is track-only for mimid
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.16 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-credential-by-ref-00.txt (224 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: credential type by_ref (suggested 0x0007, as in Rohan's gist): a LeafNode credential that is only the type and hash of another credential, delivered out of band or in another group (§1, §3). Its use is size: a large SD-CWT or X.509 chain sent once, then referenced.

RECOMMEND: track only. mimid uses BasicCredential, which is tiny; by_ref only pays off with big credentials, i.e. after the sd-cwt decision (mimid-1wgh.44.27) is 'adopt'. Then revisit together. No conflict beads.
